newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-RICKEN GOAL GIVES DORTMUND PLACE IN THE SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RICKEN GOAL GIVES DORTMUND PLACE IN THE SEMIFINALS.

text.p: A powerful 59th minute shot from midfielder Lars Ricken gave Borussia Dortmund a 1-0 win over Auxerre and a place in the semifinals of the European Cup on Wednesday.
Borussia, 3-1 up from the first leg of their quarter-final tie, resisted Auxerre pressure in the first half of the second leg on French soil before finding the opening.

Midfielder Ricken was set up by a pass from striker Stephane Chapuisat and seized his chance from 25 metres. His shot took a deflection off Auxerre midfielder Philippe Violeau's leg and left French keeper Lionel Charbonnier helpless.
Auxerre dominated play in the first half but failed to breach the visitors' tight defence.
Dortmund threatened once in the first 45 minutes, when Karlheinz Riedle saw a 22nd minute header saved by Charbonnier.
Dortmund, who now face Manchester United in the semifinals, will be without defender and captain Matthias Sammer in the first leg after he received his second yellow card of the competition.
